answer: Shared insurance pool: every new identity joins a pool of 10 members who each stake $30, and if any member is proven fake, the pool forfeits half of every stake. One fake costs about $30 at risk, 10 fakes in one pool lose $150 per slashing, 100 fakes need 10 pools and $3000 staked, so cost scales with count while an honest user stakes once. A beacon node posts a random audit seed each voyage epoch, and a raven auditor role checks 10 percent of members on chain. Limit: patient attackers can fund many pools slowly.
